Velyka Mykhaylivka Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Velyka Mykhailivka, Ukraine

Not demolished. Presumably operating since the late 19th or early 20th century, this cemetery isn't marked on any map; per neighbors, more tombstones existed some decades ago, most likely taken by locals since then. Little is documented about the Jewish community itself; population reached 1,201 (58%) by 1897, with a synagogue operating from 1867. On May 20, 1919, forces under ataman N.A. Grigoriev staged a massacre in the village. A 1920s elementary school and Soviet rural council served the community; population reached 522 by 1939. Wehrmacht occupation from August 7, 1941 saw Nazis murder 124 Jews directly at the cemetery over five days.
